name: Netlogon connections without site mapping
description: Event 5807 connection estimate, retaining the workbook's division by 255.
kql:
Event
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| where EventLog == "System" and EventID == 5807
| distinct TimeGenerated, Computer, EventID, RenderedDescription
| parse RenderedDescription with * "been " Connections " connections" *
| summarize Value = sum(todouble(Connections) / 255.0) by Timestamp = bin(TimeGenerated, _BinSize)
| extend Series = "All selected domain controllers"
| order by Timestamp asc
